decisions.statement: A launcher is a name calling the reload and then the definition the reload left.
A launcher's body sits under a name of its own rather than under the name typed.
The reload composes the whole set again rather than the one launcher that ran.
The set is parsed before that set is loaded.
A set that will not parse leaves the definitions the terminal started with.
A reload that could not be done says which step of that reload failed.
A launcher runs on the stale definition rather than not running.
Nothing here says any one launcher's body.

definition: the bounded reload a launcher runs over itself before it dispatches
